crm_notes: Lead origin: inbound web sign-up (trial). SMB, product team building an in-app assistant.
Primary contact: Mateo Rojas (CTO) — prefers short, punchy updates. Secondary: Lina Gomez (engineering).
Main pain: perceived latency in EU users; metric language: 'users complaining assistant lags ~1s+'.
Customer environment: public cloud only, want hosted_api for fastest ramp. No plans for Dedicated/Private yet.
Observed usage pattern: intermittent short-chat bursts (5-12 tokens prompt) + occasional long context for summarization (800-1,200 tokens).
Security asks: SSO/SAML for console, audit logs for token usage. They've requested SOC2 evidence — provided drive:/security doc.

What we recommended (SE notes): region pinning to closest region (eu-west-1 for EU users, us-west-2 for NA); reduce client-side socket timeout to 30s; implement streaming=false for short-turn latency-sensitive calls; enable prefix caching for repeated system prompts.

Perf tuning guidance given in call: trim unnecessary system/backstory, move large static context to embeddings+RAG, use shorter safety checks post-response. Suggested batch settings: small concurrent requests (concurrency 8) and dynamic batching disabled for sub-50-token requests to avoid head-of-line waits.
